@context.catalog.cadcraft.role: Each app: role = what it is for (a few words, on cards and Studio tiles); tagline = one line under the name; short = the one-sentence description on cards and Studio tiles. Product names, file formats (DWG, IFC, STEP, LandXML) and GD&T stay as they are.

catalog.cadcraft.tagline: The drafting table you already know how to use.
catalog.cadcraft.short: Command-line drafting with layers, blocks, dimensions and layouts that plot, plus a 3D tab for solids. Opens and saves DWG and DXF.
catalog.bimcraft.tagline: Open the model. Check it. Change it.
catalog.bimcraft.short: Open, check and edit IFC building models, with 3D, sections, schedules and clash checks.
catalog.modelcraft.tagline: Push, pull and think in three dimensions.
catalog.modelcraft.short: Fast push/pull modeling with groups, components, guides and inference snapping, for massing and early design.
catalog.markupcraft.tagline: Red-pen the set without the red pen.
catalog.markupcraft.short: Open a PDF plan set, mark it up from a saved tool chest, compare revisions and run punch lists with the whole team.
catalog.takeoffcraft.tagline: Measure the drawings. Count the work. Price the job.
catalog.takeoffcraft.short: Calibrated linear, area and count takeoff from PDF plans, with assemblies, cost columns and quantities that export.
catalog.civilcraft.tagline: From survey points to finished grade.
catalog.civilcraft.short: Surfaces from points and breaklines, alignments, profiles, corridors, grading and pipe networks. LandXML in and out.
catalog.detailcraft.tagline: Model it once. Every shop drawing follows.
catalog.detailcraft.short: Structural steel members and connections, rebar placement and bending schedules, shop drawings and NC files from one model.
catalog.partcraft.tagline: Sketch, constrain, extrude. Then build the assembly.
catalog.partcraft.short: Constrained sketches, feature history, assemblies with joints and drawings with GD&T. STEP in and out.
catalog.supercadcraft.role: One app to rule them all
catalog.supercadcraft.short: The eight apps in one: drafting, BIM, modeling, markup, takeoff, civil, detailing and parts in a single window, on the same files.
